# FrozenRandomFeatureExtractor

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A CNN layer or block with fixed random weights, used as a non-learned feature transformation in a reinforcement learning pipeline. Enables deployment of neural feature extraction on TCC/iNEST hardware without backpropagation or weight updates, simplifying in-network neuromorphic implementations.
